# Labels

Create these once (`gh label create <name> --color <hex> --description "..."`).
The changelog watcher creates `competitor-update` itself if it's missing.

| Label | Color | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `competitor-update` | `5319e7` | New entry in the Conductor or Pane changelog, opened by the watcher |
| `idea` | `a2eeef` | Feature idea, usually from triaging a `competitor-update` |
| `good first issue` | `7057ff` | Small, well-scoped, good for new contributors |
| `bug` | `d73a4a` | Something is broken |
| `m0` | `c5def5` | Milestone 0: foundations |
| `m1` | `c5def5` | Milestone 1: daily driver |
| `m2` | `c5def5` | Milestone 2: Conductor parity |
| `m3` | `c5def5` | Milestone 3: anywhere (remote, web, BYO cloud) |
| `m4` | `c5def5` | Milestone 4: beyond (orchestrator, conflict radar, ...) |
